overall: The AG found the Committee was created by the Town Manager to advise him on a decision he alone controls, so it falls within the Connelly exception and is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law; no violation.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Ashland Strategic Planning Committee failed to post notice of its meetings as the Open Meeting Law requires.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Committee was not subject to the Open Meeting Law, and thus not required to post notice or maintain minutes of its meetings.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Committee failed to keep minutes of its meetings as the Open Meeting Law requires.
